description: This Java source file defines the ContactsListFragment class, which displays and manages a list of contacts retrieved from the device's Contacts Provider. It supports searching, contact selection, and displays contact thumbnails and names, with optimized image loading and indexing features.

classes.name: ContactsListFragment
classes.description: Fragment displaying a list of contacts with search and selection capabilities, supporting two-pane layouts and optimized image loading.

classes.name: ContactsAdapter
classes.description: CursorAdapter subclass that binds contact data to list item views, supports section indexing and search highlighting.

classes.name: ContactsQuery
classes.description: Interface defining constants for querying the Contacts Provider, including URIs, projection columns, and selection criteria.

classes.name: OnContactsInteractionListener
classes.description: Interface for activity callbacks when a contact is selected or selection is cleared.

methods.name: setSearchQuery
methods.description: Sets the search query and determines if the view is a search result.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, including adapter and image loader setup.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Sets up ListView, adapters, and loaders.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Attaches the callback listener to the activity.

methods.name: onItemClick
methods.description: Handles contact item clicks, notifying the listener.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Sets up the options menu, including search view configuration.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves current search and selection state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections for adding contacts and search.

methods.name: onCreateLoader
methods.description: Creates a loader for querying contacts, with search filtering.

methods.name: onLoadFinished
methods.description: Handles loader completion, updating the cursor and UI selection.

methods.name: onLoaderReset
methods.description: Resets the loader, clearing the cursor.

methods.name: getListPreferredItemHeight
methods.description: Calculates the preferred list item height based on theme and display metrics.

methods.name: loadContactPhotoThumbnail
methods.description: Loads and scales contact thumbnail images from URIs.
